what is the total revenue across all ord: SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_revenue FROM orders
how many orders are there in total?: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders
how many customers are there?: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers
how many products are there?: SELECT COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products
what is the average order amount?: SELECT AVG(amount) AS avg_amount FROM orders
what is the total revenue in 2024?: SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_revenue FROM orders WHERE strftime('%Y', order_date) = '2024'
how many customers are in the north regi: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers WHERE region = 'North'
which product has the highest price?: SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 1
what is the total revenue by region?: SELECT c.region AS region, SUM(o.amount) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY region
what is the total revenue by product cat: SELECT p.category AS category, SUM(o.amount) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY category
what is the monthly revenue?: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month, SUM(amount) AS total_revenue FROM orders GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
who are the top 5 customers by total rev: SELECT c.name AS name, SUM(o.amount) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5
what is the average order amount by cust: SELECT c.segment AS segment, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_amount FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY segment
how many orders are there by region?: SELECT c.region AS region, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY region
what is the total revenue in 2023?: SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_revenue FROM orders WHERE strftime('%Y', order_date) = '2023'
what are the top 3 products by revenue?: SELECT p.name AS name, SUM(o.amount) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 3
who is the top customer by revenue in ea: SELECT region, name, total_revenue FROM (SELECT c.region AS region, c.name AS name, SUM(o.amount) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.region ORDER BY SUM(o.amount) DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.region, c.customer_id, c.name) WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY region
which customers have placed more than 10: SELECT c.name AS name, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 10 ORDER BY order_count DESC, name
what is revenue by category and region?: SELECT p.category AS category, c.region AS region, SUM(o.amount) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.category, c.region ORDER BY category, region
what is the average quantity per order?: SELECT AVG(quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM orders
which customers placed orders in both 20: SELECT c.name AS name FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', o.order_date) = '2023' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', o.order_date) = '2024' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 ORDER BY name
what is the second highest product price: SELECT MAX(price) AS second_highest_price FROM products WHERE price < (SELECT MAX(price) FROM products)
how many orders have an amount above the: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE amount > (SELECT AVG(amount) FROM orders)
which customer segment generates the mos: SELECT c.segment AS segment, SUM(o.amount) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 1
